_meta.RIGHTS_TODO_CONFIRM_WITH_CLIENT: Stocking a label is NOT the same as holding rights to its logo or catalogue imagery. Every name here renders as PLAIN TEXT until dealer status and image rights are confirmed in writing. See Part 7, item 1.
